summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnished with Exhibit 99.1, a press release announcing that the company has been invited to ring the Closing Bell at the New York Stock Exchange to celebrate 25 years of its listing on the NYSE. The filing includes no financial terms, board votes, advisor names, or deal mechanics. It is a commemorative ceremony, not a material special situation event. As a foreign private issuer's routine disclosure, this is a non-special situation.
